excluded.title: Never Flinch
excluded.author: Stephen King
excluded.reason: Excluded on about-ness by curator, 2026-09-29 16:23 (original iMessage "Ok, cross it, next?" answering the epilogue-ambiguity discussion). Human crime investigation drives the entire book; Trig’s dead father’s voice reads as internal trauma. An epilogue ceramic-horse voice hints at but does not confirm supernatural influence; neither it nor the voice supplies investigative clues. Not an SFF engine. Do not resurface in any tier. standing_rules.name: Absurd Shit rule
standing_rules.source: the curator: "I'm making an 'Absurd Shit'-rule: if it's too absurd to say if it's SF or Fantasy, and it's not even a Fabulation: kill it"
standing_rules.apply: Autonomous, no per-case ask: if a book is too absurd to call SF or Fantasy AND fits no Fabulation node, exclude as not SFF. Log each kill in sweep.log as '-Title (Absurd Shit rule)' and in excluded[] with reason citing the rule.
